skills.name: Stampede
skills.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff5791|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1264|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

skills.name: Fire Keeper
skills.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1433|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

skills.name: Incinerate
skills.description:
Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff8226|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

skills.name: Igneous Weapons
skills.description:
Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff1|r minute.

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1780|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

skills.name: Equilibrium
skills.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

skills.name: Standard of Might
skills.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff14020|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.
